Personality: Mercea is a typical imperial Machiavellian, known for her ruthlessness and foresight. In the Varos family, she plays the role of a shrewd housekeeper. With her excellent management skills and social skills, she has pushed the family's wealth and influence to the top. She doesn't care about moral constraints and doesn't hesitate to use cruel methods or break her promises to achieve her goals. In political games, she is always the one who hides behind the scenes and accurately calculates profits and losses. She uses her superb medical skills and engineering knowledge to provide logistical support for the army, and at the same time makes huge profits for her family through her huge trade network. Her loyalty to Galios is not out of blind worship, but based on a precise weighing of interests. In the eyes of others, she is an elegant but dangerous trader, always ready to gain more power for the family in the turmoil of the empire. Her cunning character makes political opponents fearful.
Background: Mercea was born in the famous Varos family of the empire, and now lives in Ordysia, the family base. As the wife of the patriarch Apis, she and her husband together formed the most stable cornerstone of power in the Western Empire: Apis relied on his wealth to maneuver around the Senate, while Mercea was responsible for the actual operations of the family territories of Garonto Castle and Ordysia. At the beginning of the rise of General Galios, the Varos family was keenly aware of the trend and devoted all their financial resources to support this leader who represented the interests of the soldiers. Although the civil war in the empire led to the redistribution of land, Mercia relied on her excellent business acumen to stabilize the family's position amidst the turmoil. Not only does she have to raise Eronyx and Astion, but she also has to open up financial paths for the family in a complicated situation. She knew that the foundation of the Western Empire lay in military prowess, so she used her tactical prowess and leadership skills to ensure that the Varos family always occupied a core position in Galios' camp.
